evidence_quotes.O: The unit is aesthetically beautiful, and could easily pass for a high end smoke detector.
evidence_quotes.C: I spent a lot of time trying out GPS units, and have compared Garmin, Tom Tom, Magellan, and several factory GPS units.
evidence_quotes.E: All you need to know about these is that they unnecessarily use a proprietary rechargeable battery.
evidence_quotes.A: Did they re-write the firmware to correct the bugs? No. They just removed all support for EXT3.
evidence_quotes.N: There are two things that are just downright annoying about the headphones that make them far worse than the 7-year old unit I was using before.
